verdicts.rationale: Ribeiro2006 and Ribeiro2006a share identical title, author, year, journal, volume 46/3, pages 317-319, and DOI. Zotero-style suffix key vs hand key for the same review.
abell2005mcintoshs and Abell2005 share identical title, same DOI, journal BJA, vol 45/1, pages 64-68. Duplicate import under different citekeys.
abell2005outlining and legacy shadow key 2005-Abell.1 share identical title 'On Outlining the Shape of Depiction', same DOI, journal Ratio, vol 18/1. Year-author shadow key of the indexed paper.
abell2010philosophical and AbellBantinaki2010 share identical title, authors, year, and ISBN 9780191723490. Same edited book, one entry adds publisher/DOI.

verdicts.id: applying discourse semantics and pragmatics to co reference in picture sequences
verdicts.rationale: All three share identical title and author (Abusch). 2013 is the published Sinn und Bedeutung 17 proceedings; 2012 is the inproceedings/presentation version; 2020 is a circulated ms of the same paper. Preprint/proceedings/ms of one work.

verdicts.id: temporal succession and aspectual type in visual narrative
verdicts.rationale: abusch2014temporal and abusch2002temporal share identical title, author, year 2014, booktitle (Festschrift for Irene Heim), and pages 9-29. The '2002' citekey is a mislabeled shadow key; fields agree it is the 2014 work.

All three share identical title 'Possible-Worlds Semantics for Pictures', same DOI, booktitle (Wiley Blackwell Companion to Semantics), pages 1-31. Year 2020 vs 2021 are online-vs-print variants of one chapter.

abusch2022formal (published L&P article) and abuschrooth2017formal (Amsterdam Colloquium proceedings version) share identical title 'The Formal Semantics of Free Perception in Pictorial Narratives'. Proceedings/preprint vs published journal article of the same work.
agrawala2011design and Agrawala2011 share identical title, authors, same DOI, vol 54/4, pages 60-69. Duplicate import.
aguilera2021heterogeneous and Aguilera2021 share identical title, author, same DOI, vol 199/1-2, pages 3805-3824. Duplicate import.

verdicts.id: arrows are the verbs of diagrams
verdicts.rationale: alikhani2018arrows and alikhani2020arrows share identical title, authors, booktitle, and pages 3552-3563. Both members' notes explicitly confirm they refer to the same COLING 2018 paper (ACL Anthology C18-1301). Distinct from the 'Exploring Coherence' MIPR paper, which is a separate cluster.

alikhani2018exploring, Alikhani2018, and alikhanistone2018b all share identical title 'Exploring Coherence in Visual Explanations', MIPR 2018 venue, and same DOI. Duplicate imports of one paper (distinct from the COLING 'Arrows' paper).
